connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The session automatically acknowledges a client's receipt of a message either when the session has successfully returned from a call to receive or when the message listener the session has called to process the message successfully returns

Conferma automatica dei messaggi

connection.SmFrYXJ0YUptc0RhdGFQcm92aWRlc.source: The session lazily acknowledges the delivery of messages. This is likely to result in the delivery of some duplicate messages if the JMS provider fails, so it should only be used by consumers that can tolerate duplicate messages

Conferma con duplicati consentiti
Conferma ritardata che permette duplicati
